scripts.dev:full: pnpm run docker:start && turbo run dev --filter=!./apps/launcher
scripts.docker:start: cd docker && docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d redis mongodb mongo-express mailhog silo qdrant
scripts.verify:build: pnpm --filter @atrium/gateway run build && pnpm --filter @atrium/agent run build && pnpm --filter @atrium/worker run build && pnpm --filter @atrium/console run build && pnpm --filter @atrium/launcher run build
scripts.verify:types: pnpm --filter @atrium/gateway exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @atrium/agent exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @atrium/worker exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @atrium/console exec tsc -b && pnpm --filter @atrium/launcher run type-check
scripts.verify:lint: pnpm --filter @atrium/console run lint && pnpm --filter @atrium/launcher run lint
scripts.verify: pnpm run verify:types && pnpm run verify:lint && pnpm run verify:test && pnpm run verify:build
